title: Account review decision workspace
prompt: Create a production front-end account review workspace where the next action, evidence needed, exceptions, and recovery are immediately clear. Include search, filters, review detail, validation, and simulated persistence without toolbar crowding.

title: Incident response triage dashboard
prompt: Create a dense incident triage dashboard with clear severity/action hierarchy, ownership, evidence, filters, drill-down, retry/recovery, and no ambiguous competing primary actions.

title: High-consideration product decision
prompt: Create a premium product-detail experience that reduces decision friction across variant selection, comparison, policy unknowns, cart feedback, and recovery without inventing inventory or fulfillment facts.

title: Exception approval workflow
prompt: Create an exception approval workflow with explicit prerequisites, evidence, approve/reject hierarchy, destructive separation, preserved state, and recoverable validation errors.

title: Architectural landscape studio visual finish
prompt: Create a premium landscape architecture studio website with restrained but distinctive editorial hierarchy, calibrated typography/spacing, purposeful imagery, and inquiry flow without invented projects, awards, clients, or locations.

title: Specialty home service visual finish
prompt: Create a premium local-service website with refined visual hierarchy, service decision support, proof boundaries, quote flow, and mobile polish without invented reviews, project claims, credentials, or service areas.

title: Research operations visual finish
prompt: Create a production research-operations workspace with strong information hierarchy, precise surfaces, coherent density, sample data, and clear task states without generic metric-card repetition.

title: Investment decision memo visual finish
prompt: Create a premium investment decision memo with disciplined editorial hierarchy, evidence tables, alternatives, risks, recommendation, actions, and explicit unknowns.

title: Vendor evidence provenance memo
prompt: Create a vendor due-diligence memo that clearly distinguishes supplied evidence, assumptions, unknowns, interpretations, and recommendations; unresolved claims must carry verification owners.

title: Experiment evidence boundary report
prompt: Create an experiment report that separates observed results from interpretation, limitations, assumptions, and recommendation; do not imply statistical facts that were not supplied.

title: Legal research boundary memo
prompt: Create a legal research memo using only supplied/sample authority placeholders, clearly separating authority, assumptions, unknown jurisdiction facts, analysis, and recommendations without implying legal advice.

title: Clinical education truth boundary
prompt: Create a clinical education page that visibly separates general educational content from unknown clinician, diagnosis, treatment, insurance, availability, and outcome facts.

title: Board action table at 320
prompt: Create a responsive board decision memo with an action table, risk matrix, citations, long owner names, and long identifiers that remains readable and semantically intact at 320px.

title: Postmortem timeline at narrow viewport
prompt: Create a responsive incident postmortem with timeline, evidence callouts, contributing factors, owners, and action table that preserves relationships at 320/390px.

title: Long-label multilingual operations queue
prompt: Create an operations queue with long translated labels, owner names, statuses, evidence notes, exceptions, and primary actions that remains task-complete at 320px.

title: Audit handoff with sticky controls
prompt: Create a responsive audit handoff workflow with evidence, status, sticky navigation/action controls, errors, and confirmation; ensure no collision at 320/390/768px.

title: Keyboard-first settings recovery
prompt: Create a settings workflow with clear action hierarchy, validation, unsaved-state warning, retry/recovery, keyboard completion, and visible focus while keeping destructive reset separate.

title: Filter context preservation
prompt: Create an investigative dashboard where filter/search/selection context is preserved through drill-down, error, retry, and return; show sample-data boundaries clearly.

title: Generated media proof boundary
prompt: Create a premium local-service concept using generated imagery for atmosphere while making it impossible to mistake those visuals for completed projects, customer proof, or verified staff.

title: Floor-capable usability evidence
prompt: Create a dense front-end workflow and include observable evidence for orientation, primary-action clarity, state preservation, success/error feedback, recovery, keyboard completion, and 320px task completion.
